C2_C4_kinematics.definitions:
T35-diag A — per-run grasp kinematics from existing closed-loop records (frames.jsonl only, MuJoCo GT).

usage: a_runs.py OUT_JSON RUN_DIR [RUN_DIR ...]

Per control row (t, chunk_seq, step_in_chunk):
  grip_cmd        : applied_ctrl.gripper[0] (left, 1 = open) — what was sent (refined chunk col 7 for safe runs)
  grip_ref_cmd    : actions_reference[step, 7] of that chunk's planning row (E0 runs: actions = reference)
  open_meas       : |qpos[27]| / 0.045 (measured left finger opening, 1 = open)
  apple           : qpos[38:41] (GT apple centre, world); disp_xy_mm / dz_mm from the first control row
  d_exec_mm       : min mj_geomDistance(left finger geoms (ee_finger_l1, ee_finger_l2), apple_geom) at the measured qpos
  d_l1_mm/d_l2_mm : same, per finger body
  d_ref_mm        : same with the left+right arm joints (left_arm_0..6, right_arm_0..6) replaced by actions_reference[step]
                    (16D cols 0-6 / 8-14), all other qpos (fingers, torso, apple) = measured row  -> the policy's commanded pose
  d_refined_mm    : same with actions[step] (the chunk that was sent)
  E0 records have no chunk arrays (planning actions = None): reference = refined = the control row's applied_ctrl (arm 14, gripper 2)
  mid_rel_apple_mm: midpoint of the two finger-side witness points (closest point of ee_finger_l1 / ee_finger_l2 to the apple)
                    - apple centre, world frame (mm), measured / ref / refined
Per planning row: refined - reference per joint, rows 0-7 (deg, |.| max over rows), arm cols 0-6, 8-14.
Events:
  t_close        : first control row with grip_cmd < 0.5 (analyze_p2r definition)
  t_close_ref    : first control row with grip_ref_cmd < 0.5
  at_close       : the row values at t_close; window stats over [t_close, t_close + 16) control rows
  n_close_cycles : count of grip_cmd crossings >=0.5 -> <0.5
Success / grasp_t / place_t: ../T28/E0/analyze_e0.py:analyze (same definitions as T28-T34).
Distances: GT geometry (MuJoCo 3.11 convex-hull mesh distance; negative = penetration); invalid witness pairs -> +inf, counted.
C2_C4_kinematics.cycles_definitions:
T35-diag A2 — per close cycle stats from a/a_runs.json timelines.
cycle = maximal run of control rows with grip_cmd < 0.5 (applied, left). Per cycle: t_start, t_end, n rows,
min open_meas (and t), at that row: d_l1/d_l2 (GT finger-apple, mm), mid_rel_apple (witness midpoint - apple centre, world mm),
d_ref (policy-commanded arm pose at that row), max apple dz / xy displacement during the cycle (mm, from run start),
and apple xy displacement from cycle start to cycle end (mm).
usage: cycles.py -> a/cycles.json

C1_to_ablation.definitions:
T35-diag B — which rows / terms drive refined - reference in the 10 chunks before and after the first close command
(4 failed T34 runs; T34 records, working tree = T34 code, md5-checked).

usage: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=/mnt/dev/work <py> b_ablation.py RUN [RUN ...]   (RUN = E3b_ep1800_r1 ...)

Window: planning rows (local seq) s_close-10 .. s_close+10, s_close = chunk of the first control row with applied left
gripper < 0.5 (a/a_runs.json t_close). Only chunks paired to a server npz (T34 p/<COND>_analysis.json 'server_chunk').
Inputs restored with benchmark.trajopt.experiments.fixed_input_ablation (T24 tool) functions, as T31diag d2_rows_ablation.py:
  settings  : parse_server_log(serve_safe_<port>.log) + manifest
  field     : build_field(chunk npz) — coarse + fine + target-free layer when recorded (outside = esdf max_distance)
  q_now     : paired local planning row qpos
  contact   : T.contact_policy(has_target, has_free, attached) -> manipulated_link_margin + target_free_mask; scene = T.make_scene
  fingers   : FingerJointMap.path(summary.finger_joints.opening_norm, reference cols 7/15) -> set_joint_parameter_path
HELD chunks (summary.grasp.attached_in_constraints and grasp.attached.held): held spheres = recorded
  held.spheres_parent_frame {centre_m, radius_mm} on held.frame_link -> scene.attached_points / attached_parent_link /
  attached_radii (T32 H2 path of scene_from_constraint_set); manipulated_spheres = those spheres through FK at q_now;
  manipulated_link_margin = contact_policy(has_target=True, attached=False) margin; target_free_mask None.
  (T24 tool skips attached chunks; this is the T31diag/T33 extension with the T34 held-sphere record.)
Rows (reference = TO initial iterate, refined = recorded output), executed window = planned horizon:
  worst row + rows with clearance < 0: link ('attached[i]' for held spheres), tier (field.answer_tier), clearance mm,
  GT nearest body (mj_geomDistance probe, P1-2 helper) and nearest excluding apple.
Fidelity: reconstructed worst_row(refined) vs recorded to.metrics.clearance_m / max_violation_pair (step, query).
Limits: reference and refined overshoot vs TO limits (Meter.overshoot) and per joint beyond MuJoCo jnt_range of
  model_transport.xml (rad; 0 = inside); recorded to.metrics.initial_limit_overshoot / limit_overshoot.
Ablation (per chunk, fresh solver, clock off, max_iterations = recorded sqp_iterations):
  replay / no_collision / no_limits / no_continuity / no_smooth  (+ replay_3iter)
  dev = max over arm joints and planned steps of |traj - reference| (deg), per joint; fingertip displacement (mm);
  returned path; vs_recorded_refined_max_deg (replay fidelity).
Recorded refined vs reference: Meter.compare -> joint dev and fingertip (mean of left finger spheres) displacement per step (mm).
Join: |reference_chunk[0] - previous chunk's recorded refined_chunk[8]| per column (deg) — the row the previous chunk would
  have commanded next (8 rows executed per chunk).
Recorded per chunk: returned, returned_index, candidates, sqp_iterations, verdict kinds; per-joint recorded dev (deg).
C1_to_ablation.summary_definitions:
T35-diag B summary — per run over the +-10 chunk window around the first close command (b/b_<run>.json).
Per chunk: recorded dev (deg, planned horizon), fingertip displacement refined vs reference (mm, max over steps),
join |ref[0]-prev refined[8]| (deg, arm max), returned, per-variant dev, 'driver' = variants whose dev <= 0.25 * replay dev
when replay dev >= 0.5 deg (term whose removal takes the deviation away), reference worst row (link, tier, clearance, GT nearest),
limits (recorded initial_limit_overshoot position > 0; reference beyond TO position limits; reference/refined beyond MJCF).
usage: b_summary.py -> b/b_summary.json

C3_perception.definitions:
T35-diag C — perception / identity per chunk around the first close command, all 12 T34 runs.

usage: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=/mnt/dev/work <py> c_perception.py -> c/c_perception.json
Sources: T34 p/<COND>_analysis.json (manipulated, exclusion, ball, grasp_latch, manip_extra) and p/<COND>_analysis_extra.json
(association, anchor, decision, frozen, ball_vs_gt_apple) — same definitions as T34 (analyze_e3_base.py / analyze_e3_extra.py).
Window: local seq s_close-10 .. s_close+10 (s_close from a/a_runs.json t_close). Also whole run up to t_close ('pre_close').
Per chunk:
  manip            : manipulated {id, state, to_apple_mm (centroid -> GT apple centre), nearest_centre, admissible_reason}
  manip_is_apple   : nearest_centre == 'apple'  (T28 rule)
  association      : extra association outcome ; decision reason ; anchor source ; switched_from
  split            : manip_extra split_n_triggered / split_n_split
  hand             : manip_extra.hand {occluded_by_hand, gap_mm}
  exclusion        : source / active / grasp_active / mechanism
  ball             : extra ball_vs_gt_apple {radius_mm, apple_centre_dist_mm, centre_inside, whole_inside (+34 mm)}
  held cover       : held chunks — recorded held.spheres_parent_frame ('query', T34 lifted spheres) and
                     held.filter_spheres_parent_frame ('filter', fit + pad) through constraint-model FK at q_now (fixed_input_ablation
                     build_robot) -> base -> world (P1-2 base_to_world); GT apple (planning-row qpos[38:41]):
                     max over apple surface of the distance outside the sphere union, sampled as the apple centre +
                     34 mm * 162 unit directions; 'whole_inside' = no sample outside any sphere; also the body-sphere
                     centre-to-apple-centre distance.
  latch            : grasp_latch state / attach / detach
Counts per run and window: n chunks manip_is_apple False, n occluded_by_hand, n split triggered / accepted, n ball whole_inside
False (when a ball exists), n frozen, association outcome counts.

C4_settle_hold.definitions:
T35-diag A3 — grasp settle and hold metrics per run (a/a_runs.json).
t_settle = last control row of the FIRST close cycle (applied left gripper cmd < 0.5); hold window = the next 24 control rows.
At t_settle: open_meas, d_l1/d_l2 (GT finger-apple, mm), contact midpoint (witness mid) - apple centre (world mm),
  body midpoint (finger body origins) - apple centre for measured / reference-commanded / refined-commanded arm pose,
  and differences ref - measured, refined - ref (mm).
Hold window: cmd median, min open_meas and open drop from t_settle, first row with min(d_l1, d_l2) > 1 mm ('contact_lost_t'),
  apple dz max (mm) and dz at contact loss, witness-mid z change (max - value at settle, mm), apple xy displacement max.
usage: settle.py -> a/settle.json

C1_field_probe.definitions:
T35-diag D — what the field has at the reference worst rows of the chunks where collision drives the TO shift.

usage: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=/mnt/dev/work <py> d_probe.py -> d/d_probe.json
For each (run, t) listed: rebuild the chunk's field and scene exactly as b_ablation.py (held spheres for held chunks), take every
reference row with clearance < 0 (and the worst row), and report: link, step, tier, clearance (mm), field distance d(c), the
field nearest-surface estimate p = c - d(c) * grad/|grad| (base), GT surface distance per body at p (P1-2 probe) -> nearest GT
body at p and its distance (mm), height of p above the GT apple top (apple centre z + 34 mm) and above the table plane
(support_mask TLS plane, z > 0.5 m points), and the GT sphere-centre surface distances (apple / banana / table, minus r).
Also the recorded field layers present (esdf_free recorded?) and esdf_extra.held_free (voxels freed).

C5_revoke.definitions:
T35-diag E — E3b_ep1800_r1 attach (t=144) / attach_revoked (t=160): GT around t=136..176 from a/a_runs.json + T34 revoke detail.
Per control row: grip cmd, measured opening, d_l1/d_l2 (GT finger-apple, mm), contact midpoint - apple centre (world mm, witness),
apple dz / xy displacement from run start (mm), apple world position. 'in_hand' = both d_l1 and d_l2 <= 1.0 mm.
Latch records (T34 p/E3b_revoke_detail.json): attach / hold_checks / revoke reasons with their feedback seq and chunk t.
Feedback rows of a chunk decision = control rows of the previous chunk (feedback seq = chunk seq - 1).
usage: revoke_gt.py -> e/revoke_gt.json
